title: SpaceX intends to invest up to $100 billion in massive Louisiana spaceport
summary: The announcement capped months of speculation about SpaceX’s interest in a sprawling parcel of land along the Gulf coast of Louisiana, which offers room to build multiple launch towers and offers access to the methane propellant that fuels the Starship rocket.
